stops.name: 18 Oakwood Drive
stops.text: Welcome to 18 Oakwood Drive, a standout contemporary home offering over twenty-seven hundred square feet of beautifully designed living space. From the curb, you can immediately appreciate its clean architectural lines and tranquil setting. Let's head inside and explore.

stops.name: Entry
stops.text: Step inside to a bright, welcoming foyer featuring rich wood floors and crisp white walls. Daylight streams right through the front windows, setting a warm tone the moment you arrive. From here, you have effortless access into both the living room and the kitchen.

stops.name: Living Room 1
stops.text: This expansive living room is truly the showpiece of the home, giving you nearly five hundred square feet to relax and entertain. Massive expanses of glass wash the contemporary interior in natural light. It connects gracefully to both the entry and central hall, making gatherings feel effortless.

stops.name: Hallway
stops.text: This wide central hallway effortlessly ties every wing of the home together.

stops.name: Kitchen 1
stops.text: Cooks will love this bright, efficient kitchen surrounded by dual-aspect windows that keep the space cheerful all day. There is plenty of room for meal prep, with warm floors complementing the sleek surfaces. It transitions right into the dining area for easy weeknight dinners.

stops.name: Dining Room 1
stops.text: Just off the kitchen, the dedicated dining room provides an intimate yet airy setting for family feasts. A generous window frames outdoor views while you dine. It sits perfectly positioned between the kitchen and the main hall.

stops.name: Home Office
stops.text: Tucked away for privacy, this dedicated home office makes remote work a breeze. The quiet window nook brings in just the right amount of afternoon glow. It is an ideal spot to focus without household distractions.

stops.name: Bedroom 1
stops.text: The primary bedroom is a peaceful retreat, boasting over three hundred and twenty square feet of serene space. Broad picture windows stretch across the main wall, capturing morning light across the hardwood floors. It easily accommodates a king suite and extra lounge seating.

stops.name: Bedroom 3
stops.text: Next up is this comfortable secondary bedroom, offering generous proportions and high ceilings. Its large window overlooks the grounds, keeping the room vibrant and inviting. It is ready to serve as a wonderful guest suite or kids' bedroom.

stops.name: Bedroom 2
stops.text: Across the corridor sits another well-proportioned bedroom with versatile layout options. Natural light filters in through the window, accentuating the clean finishes. Whether you need a nursery, hobby space, or extra bedroom, this room adapts easily.

stops.name: Bathroom 1
stops.text: This full bathroom is finished in crisp neutrals that maximize light and simplicity. An exterior window provides fresh ventilation and soft daylight. It is conveniently situated close to the secondary bedrooms.

stops.name: Bathroom 2
stops.text: The home's second bathroom mirrors that same pristine, contemporary design aesthetic. It features its own window for natural light, ensuring every corner feels fresh and airy. Ideal for busy mornings when everyone is getting ready at once.

stops.name: Laundry Room
stops.text: Practicality meets light in this dedicated laundry room, fitted with corner windows to keep chores bright. Having a separate, enclosed utility space helps keep the rest of your home organized and clutter-free.

stops.name: Garage
stops.text: Finally, we finish in the spacious attached garage, giving you over three hundred and sixty square feet for parking, storage, or a workshop. Ample windows bring in practical natural light, while direct interior access makes arriving home easy. Thank you for touring 18 Oakwood Drive, and we hope to welcome you home soon.
